title: T and Z, partial seed coat patterning genes in common bean, provide insight into the structure and protein interactions of a plant MBW complex.
authors: McClean, Phillip E; Roy, Jayanta; Colbert, Christopher L; Osborne, Caroline; Lee, Rian; Miklas, Phillip N; Osorno, Juan M
one_liner_zh: 该文通过AlphaFold2建模和突变分析研究菜豆MBW复合物中MYB-bHLH-WDR蛋白互作，虽非TF-DNA结合体系，但蛋白复合物界面建模方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Flavonoids are secondary metabolites associated with plant seed coat and flower color. These compounds provide health benefits to humans as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant compounds. The expression of the late biosynthetic genes in the flavonoid pathway is controlled by a ternary MBW protein complex consisting of interfacing MYB, beta-helix-loop-helix (bHLH), and WD40 Repeat (WDR) proteins. P, the master regulator gene of the flavonoid expression in common bean (Phaseolus vulgaris L.), was recently determined to encode a bHLH protein. The T and Z genes control the distribution of color in bean seeds and flowers and have historically been considered regulators of the flavonoid gene expression. T and Z candidates were identified using reverse genetics based on genetic mapping, phylogenetic analysis, and mutant analysis. Domain and AlphaFold2 structure analyses determined that T encodes a seven-bladed beta-propeller WDR protein, while Z encodes a R2R3 MYB protein. Deletions and SNPs in T and Z mutants, respectively, altered the 3D structure of these proteins. Modeling of the Z MYB/P bHLH/T WDR MBW complex identified interfacing sequence domains and motifs in all three genes that are conserved in dicots. One Z MYB motif is a possible beta-molecular recognition feature (beta-MoRF) that only appears in a structured state when Z MYB is modeled as a component of a MBW complex. Complexes containing mutant T and Z proteins changed the interaction of members of the complex in ways that would alter their role in regulating the expression of genes in the flavonoid pathway.
abstract_zh: 黄酮类化合物是与植物种皮和花色相关的次生代谢产物。这些化合物作为抗炎和抗氧化剂，为人类提供健康益处。黄酮类化合物生物合成途径中晚期生物合成基因的表达受由相互作用的MYB、β-螺旋-环-螺旋（bHLH）和WD40重复（WDR）蛋白组成的三元MBW蛋白复合物调控。P基因是普通菜豆（Phaseolus vulgaris L.）中黄酮类化合物表达的主调控基因，最近被确定为编码bHLH蛋白。T和Z基因控制豆种子和花中颜色的分布，历史上被认为是黄酮类化合物基因表达的调控因子。通过基于遗传作图、系统发育分析和突变体分析的反向遗传学方法，鉴定了T和Z候选基因。结构域和AlphaFold2结构分析确定T编码一个七叶β-螺旋桨WDR蛋白，而Z编码一个R2R3 MYB蛋白。T和Z突变体中的缺失和单核苷酸多态性（SNPs）分别改变了这些蛋白的三维结构。对Z MYB/P bHLH/T WDR MBW复合物的建模，识别了所有三个基因中在双子叶植物中保守的界面序列结构域和基序。一个Z MYB基序可能是β-分子识别特征（beta-MoRF），仅在Z MYB作为MBW复合物组分建模时才以结构化状态出现。含有突变T和Z蛋白的复合物改变了复合物成员间的相互作用，其方式会改变它们在调控黄酮类化合物途径基因表达中的作用。
